text: A.I. can act. But who decides?
Morph gives a Hermes agent one adaptive workspace across your applications, and keeps you in control of every change.
This is a real GitHub repository, with ten open issues.
We ask Hermes to triage them. It reads every issue through Morph, and proposes four changes.
Morph composes a workspace for that goal, planned by the model from the live schema.
The agent can only propose. Each change waits, with its exact before and after. On GitHub, nothing has moved.
A person approves. Morph writes to GitHub, then reads each issue back to verify it.
And on GitHub itself: duplicates closed, the title fixed, the bug assigned.
Every step lands in a tamper-evident log. Change the goal, and the interface adapts. Any A.P.I. with an Open A.P.I. document connects the same way.
Morph. Software that adapts to you. Powered by Hermes Agent.
